content.content: When is the family reunion going to be, based on the emails? Give me the date and time in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.

```python
# Search for emails related to "family reunion"
emails = search_emails(query="family reunion", sender=None)

# Check if any emails were found
if not emails:
    raise ValueError("No emails found regarding 'family reunion'.")

# Use the AI assistant to extract the date and time from the email bodies
# We pass the emails to the AI assistant to parse the unstructured text
reunion_info = query_ai_assistant(
    query=f"Find the date and time of the family reunion mentioned in the following emails. Return the date and time in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' format. If there are multiple, pick the most likely upcoming one or the main event details.\n\nEmails: {emails}",
    output_schema=str
)

# Print the result
print(reunion_info)
```
